services.name: Single Class
services.desc: Get the Mighty experience at home, on the road, or just about anywhere with our wide variety of LIVE online workout classes - including mat Pilates, strength training, cardio, and more! Our dynamic instructors offer fine-tuned, personalized instruction with small class sizes of less than 20 per class that allow you to connect with the instructor and with one another. Continue your practice from the comfort of your own home to strengthen your body & mind. No experience or equipment required. Sign-up the same way you do for studio classes - via Mindbody online, the app, by calling or emailing the studio.
